_readme: Filler ad cards for edition pages. When a category grid in an HTML edition (editions/<date>/<slot>.html) has an ODD item count that is not a multiple of 3 (1, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19 ...), tools/publish.py appends exactly ONE of these ads as a card at the end of that category. Even counts and multiples of 3 get none. Ads are taken in list order starting from a per-page offset, so the same ad never appears twice in a row on a page. Fields: id, kind ("sponsor" or "sub"), active (false = skipped), color (accent), art (big words on the picture), label (small line next to the Ad tag), title, text, cta, href (relative to the site root, or https:/mailto:). Keep the list at 5 active ads. Edit and run tools/publish.py; every edition page is rebuilt. These cards are house ads that send readers to subscribe or to become a sponsor; they are not rentable ad space, so keep the copy short hype with no prices, rates, specs or 'your ad here' wording. Subscribe cards point to about.html#sub-access until membership goes live (at the Oct 31, 2026 cutover switch their href to members/, the join page).
